items.title: 電動車普及率全球領先 這國為何對智慧眼鏡喊卡？
items.title_en: Electric Vehicle Adoption Leads the World: Why Is This Country Slamming the Brakes on Smart Glasses?
paras: 挪威電動車市占率已達96%至98%，在從燃油車轉向電動車的過程中，成為全球領先國家。但在智慧眼鏡技術方面，可別期待挪威也會有96%的消費者戴上最新款產品。
根據《TechCrunch》報導，挪威正考慮禁止智慧眼鏡，尤其是能夠拍照的穿戴式裝置。監管機構指出，由於智慧眼鏡使用者可以在他人不知情、也無法事先同意情況下拍攝照片，因此引發隱私疑慮。
挪威數位部長Karianne Tung近日向《法新社》表示，挪威正考慮對配備攝影功能的智慧眼鏡進行監管。
Tung指出，目前趨勢是將攝影機與麥克風等設備整合進智慧眼鏡、帽子及耳機等產品。
她表示，「我們必須防止這些設備被用來在公共場所監視其他人。」
根據Tung，相關監管措施可能包括禁止智慧眼鏡在公共場所使用臉部辨識功能。
報導指出，由於智慧眼鏡可以在未經他人同意的情況下拍照，因此部分智慧眼鏡被貼上「變態眼鏡」(pervert glasses)的標籤，而這個稱呼顯然不太可能受到消費者歡迎。
對Meta Platforms(META-US)與Snap(SNAP-US)而言，智慧眼鏡近年來一直是兩家公司重點押注產品之一。
Meta已投入數十億美元開發智慧眼鏡，並在今年2月的第60屆超級盃(Super Bowl)期間投放多支廣告。廣告中可以看到消費者進行各種極限運動，並喊出「嘿！Meta，幫我錄下來」。
蘋果(AAPL-US)預計明年推出備受期待的智慧眼鏡。這款消費性產品同樣具備拍照與錄影功能。
雖然拍攝運動過程及某些第一人稱視角畫面，確實可能為消費者帶來便利，但挪威目前強烈的反彈顯示，在相關法規與安全措施備妥之前，智慧眼鏡可能還沒準備好迎接大規模普及。
有些國家至今仍未準備好迎接電動車，但挪威早已超前。但面對所謂的「變態眼鏡」，這個電動車普及率全球領先的國家，似乎就沒那麼快準備好了。
paras_en: Norway's electric‑vehicle market share has reached 96% to 98%, making it a global leader as it shifts from fuel‑powered cars to EVs. However, when it comes to smart‑glasses technology, don’t expect Norway to see 96% of consumers wearing the latest models.

According to TechCrunch, Norway is considering a ban on smart glasses, especially wearable devices that can take photos. Regulators say the ability of smart‑glasses users to capture images without the subject’s knowledge or consent raises privacy concerns.
Norway’s digital minister Karianne Tung recently told AFP that the country is weighing regulation of smart glasses equipped with photographic functions.
Tung noted that the current trend is to integrate cameras, microphones and other sensors into smart glasses, hats and ear‑wear.
She said, “We must prevent these devices from being used to surveil people in public spaces.”
According to Tung, possible regulatory measures could include prohibiting the use of facial‑recognition features on smart glasses in public areas.
The report adds that because smart glasses can take photos without others’ consent, some have been labeled “pervert glasses,” a nickname unlikely to win consumer favor.
For Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Snap (SNAP‑US), smart glasses have been a key product focus in recent years.

Meta has poured billions of dollars into developing smart glasses and ran multiple ads during the 60th Super Bowl in February, showing consumers performing extreme sports and shouting, “Hey Meta, record this for me.”
Apple (AAPL‑US) expects to launch a highly anticipated smart‑glass product next year, which will also feature photo and video capabilities.

While capturing sports activities and first‑person perspectives can indeed be convenient for users, Norway’s strong backlash shows that until relevant regulations and safety measures are in place, smart glasses may not be ready for mass adoption.

Some countries are still not prepared for electric vehicles, but Norway is already ahead. Yet faced with the so‑called “pervert glasses,” this world‑leading EV nation doesn’t seem ready to embrace them anytime soon.

items.title: 房地合一重購退稅踩雷！他因「這原因」賣房百萬稅款全遭追回
items.title_en: Land-and-House Integrated Tax Re‑purchase Refund Pitfall! He Lost All the Million‑Dollar Tax Refund Because of This Reason
paras: 財政部北區國稅局表示，個人適用房地合一稅重購自住房地稅額扣抵或退還後，重購之新房地在5年內若改作其他用途或再行移轉，國稅局將依法追繳原扣抵或退還的稅款。即使民眾主張因工作調職等非自願因素出售，仍不符自住規定，無法免除追繳。民眾在申請房地合一稅重購退稅時，務必特別留意5年列管期的各項限制，以免失去稅務優惠權益。
依據所得稅法第14條之8規定，個人適用重購自住房地稅額扣抵或退還，無論是「先售後購」或「先購後售」，買賣時間均須在2年之內。適用條件包含本人、配偶或未成年子女須於出售及購買房屋辦竣戶籍登記並實際居住，且該房地無出租、供營業或執行業務使用。符合條件者，可依重購價額占出售價額的比率，計算退還或扣抵應納稅額。
不過，政府為防止短期炒作及投機行為，重購退稅設有嚴格的「5年列管期」。只要在重購後5年內將新房地移轉所有權、遷出戶籍、未實際自住，或是改為出租、轉供營業與執行業務使用，國稅局都會依法追繳原本扣抵或退還的稅額。
北區國稅局舉例，轄內甲君於2021年6月以865萬元出售原自住房地，並申報繳納房地合一稅108萬元。隨後甲君於2022年9月以838萬元重購新房地，因符合規定，國稅局核准按比例退還已繳稅額104萬餘元。然而，甲君卻在2024年3月將該新房地再次出售，國稅局因而依法追繳原先已退還的104萬餘元稅額。
甲君雖提出復查，主張是因為工作調職才不得不出售重購的新房地，屬於非自願出售，希望能免予追繳。但國稅局認為，新房地移轉他人後已無供其個人自住使用的事實，並不符合重購自住優惠政策的初衷，因此駁回其復查申請。
國稅局特別提醒民眾，重購退稅是給予長期自住者的租稅優惠，5年內不得任意變更用途或賣出。民眾若對房地合一稅重購退稅的法令規範或適用條件有任何疑問，可洽詢國稅局免費服務專線0800-000321，以保障自身的節稅權益。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance’s North District National Tax Bureau says that when an individual claims a tax credit or refund for the land‑and‑house integrated tax on a re‑purchased primary residence, if the newly bought property is used for another purpose or transferred again within five years, the bureau will legally recover the previously credited or refunded tax. Even if the seller argues that the sale was forced by a job transfer or other involuntary reasons, it does not meet the self‑occupation requirement and the recovery cannot be waived. Taxpayers applying for the re‑purchase refund must pay close attention to all restrictions during the five‑year monitoring period to avoid losing the tax benefit.

According to Article 14‑8 of the Income Tax Act, individuals eligible for a tax credit or refund on a re‑purchased primary residence must complete the purchase and sale within two years, whether the transaction is “sell first, buy later” or “buy first, sell later.” The conditions require that the taxpayer, spouse, or minor children register the household and actually reside in the sold and purchased homes, and that the property is not rented out, used for business, or for any commercial activity. Qualified taxpayers can calculate the refundable or creditable tax amount based on the ratio of the re‑purchase price to the sale price.

However, to curb short‑term speculation, the re‑purchase refund is subject to a strict five‑year monitoring period. If, within five years of the re‑purchase, the owner transfers the new property’s title, moves the household registration out, fails to actually reside there, or converts it to rental, business, or other commercial use, the National Tax Bureau will legally reclaim the originally credited or refunded tax.

The North District Tax Bureau gave an example: Mr. Jia sold his original primary residence in June 2021 for NT$8.65 million and paid NT$1.08 million in land‑and‑house integrated tax. He then re‑purchased a new property in September 2022 for NT$8.38 million; because he met the requirements, the bureau approved a proportional refund of over NT$1.04 million. However, Jia sold the new property again in March 2024, prompting the bureau to recover the previously refunded NT$1.04 million in tax.

Jia filed for a review, claiming the sale was forced by a job transfer and therefore involuntary, seeking exemption from the recovery. The bureau rejected his claim, stating that once the new property was transferred to another party it no longer served personal residence purposes and thus violated the original intent of the re‑purchase self‑occupation tax incentive.

The bureau reminds the public that the re‑purchase refund is a tax incentive for long‑term homeowners and cannot be arbitrarily changed in use or sold within five years. Anyone with questions about the legal provisions or eligibility for the land‑and‑house integrated tax re‑purchase refund should contact the free service line 0800‑000321 to protect their tax‑saving rights.

items.title: AI不只炒晶片！用電暴增推升強勁需求 百達：電網與能源轉型成資金新寵
items.title_en: AI Not Just About Chips! Surging Electricity Use Fuels Strong Demand – Pictet: Power Grids and Energy Transition Become New Capital Favorites
paras: 人工智慧（AI）資料中心與加密貨幣算力擴張，正引爆全球龐大電力需求，資金焦點正順勢由AI晶片延伸至低碳且穩定的電力供給，使電網、儲能與能源效率成為新一輪資本支出核心。美國能源資訊署（EIA）預估，美國用電量將由2025年創新高的4,269兆度（kWh），升至2027年的4,391兆度（kWh）。瑞士百達資產管理表示，市場焦點已從發電量轉向電網調度與系統整合，電網「升級」成為能源轉型能否落地的主要關鍵，相關能源基金亦受惠，如百達-能源轉型基金積極布局，近1年報酬率達36.07%，近3年報酬率更近6成。
AI應用加速普及，大型科技業者積極打造高密度運算設施，不僅推升總體用電量，更暴露出區域電網輸送與穩定供電能力的不足。EIA預估，2025年至2027年間美國再生能源發電占比將升至27%，煤炭則降至15%，顯示電力結構持續往低碳傾斜。百達投顧指出，AI帶動的電力需求具備長期性，產業資本支出正從傳統風電、太陽能發電設備，大幅擴及輸配電網路、儲能系統、電力管理軟體及節能技術。
隨著再生能源發電的間歇性特質凸顯，智慧電網與儲能設備成為平衡尖離峰供需、提升電網韌性的重要工具。具備電網設備、電力電子與能源管理能力的企業，將優先受惠於長期資本支出循環。此外，中東局勢引發油價波動與通膨擔憂，美國聯準會7月底維持利率於3.5%至3.75%，儘管短期利率與能源價格影響融資環境，但各國建構低碳且具韌性的能源供應體系，仍是中長期不可逆的趨勢。
投資人參與AI基礎建設熱潮，除了佈局上游供應鏈，亦可關注電力系統升級帶來的延續性資金動能。百達-能源轉型聚焦AI引爆的電力需求，積極佈局節能半導體、電氣化、儲能與智慧電網等相關標的。根據理柏截至2026年7月31日統計，該基金近1年報酬率達36.07%，近3年報酬率更達57.22%，績效位居同類型基金前四分之一，展現低碳轉型與電力重估趨勢下的投資價值。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) data centers and the expansion of cryptocurrency mining power are igniting massive global electricity demand, shifting capital focus from AI chips to low‑carbon, reliable power supply. Power grids, storage and energy‑efficiency are becoming the core of the next wave of capital spending. The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) projects U.S. electricity consumption to rise from a record 4,269 TWh in 2025 to 4,391 TWh in 2027. Swiss asset manager Pictet says market attention has moved from generation capacity to grid dispatch and system integration, with grid “upgrades” now the key to delivering the energy transition. Related energy funds are benefiting, such as the Pictet‑Energy Transition Fund, which has delivered a 36.07% return over the past year and nearly 60% over the past three years.

AI adoption is accelerating, and large tech firms are building high‑density computing facilities that not only boost overall electricity use but also expose shortcomings in regional grid transmission and stable supply. The EIA estimates that from 2025 to 2027 the share of renewable generation in the U.S. will rise to 27% while coal falls to 15%, indicating a continued shift toward low‑carbon power. Pictet analysts note that AI‑driven electricity demand is long‑term, and industry capex is expanding from traditional wind and solar equipment to transmission and distribution networks, storage systems, power‑management software and energy‑saving technologies.

As the intermittent nature of renewable generation becomes more pronounced, smart grids and storage assets are emerging as crucial tools to balance peak‑to‑off‑peak supply‑demand and enhance grid resilience. Companies that possess grid equipment, power electronics and energy‑management capabilities will be the primary beneficiaries of the long‑term capex cycle. Moreover, Middle‑East tensions have sparked oil‑price volatility and inflation concerns, while the U.S. Federal Reserve kept rates at 3.5%‑3.75% at the end of July. Although short‑term rates and energy prices affect financing conditions, nations’ efforts to build low‑carbon, resilient energy supply systems remain an irreversible mid‑ to long‑term trend.

Investors riding the AI infrastructure wave can not only target upstream supply chains but also tap the sustained capital momentum from power‑system upgrades. The Pictet‑Energy Transition fund focuses on the electricity demand sparked by AI, actively investing in energy‑efficient semiconductors, electrification, storage and smart‑grid related assets. According to Lipper data as of July 31 2026, the fund has achieved a 36.07% return over the past year and a 57.22% return over the past three years, placing it in the top quartile of peer funds and demonstrating the investment value of low‑carbon transition and power re‑valuation trends.

items.title: 黃金還能漲？預計荷姆茲海峽Q4重開、花旗喊價5000美元
items.title_en: Can Gold Still Rise? Anticipating a Q4 Reopening of the Hormuz Strait, Citi Prices Gold at $5,000
paras: 中東局勢持續牽動能源市場，荷姆茲海峽何時恢復通航，正成為左右油價、通膨與貴金屬走勢的重要變數。花旗（Citi）最新大宗商品展望指出，若海峽恢復通航，油價回落可能透過通膨、利率與美元等傳導機制，反而為黃金帶來支撐。
花旗的基本情境是，荷姆茲海峽將在2026年第4季恢復通航。該行認為，能源價格下降可望減輕通膨壓力，為聯準會（Fed）進一步轉向寬鬆提供空間，並可能帶動美元與實質利率走低，降低持有黃金的機會成本。
此外，油價回落也可能緩解新興市場的財政與外部收支壓力，進而釋放此前受到抑制的實體黃金需求。若金價持續走高並形成更強的價格動能，散戶投資人也可能重新進場，進一步強化黃金漲勢。
花旗維持貴金屬多頭看法，將黃金未來0至3個月目標價設定為每盎司4800美元，6至12個月目標價則為5000美元，均高於目前約4500美元的現貨價格。

荷姆茲海峽若重啟　油價恐快速回落

目前能源市場仍處於異常狀態。花旗將2026年第3季布蘭特原油預測上調至每桶86美元，但維持第4季70美元、2027年65美元的預測不變。
目前全球油品綜合價格已超過每桶120美元，但原油價格本身尚未突破2022年高點，市場異常主要反映在煉油利潤率大幅走高。
花旗認為，這種情況難以長期維持。該行指出，伊朗正面臨本幣貶值與石油收入下滑壓力，因此存在打破封鎖的動機；另一方面，高油價也將加大美國經濟及金融市場壓力，隨著11月期中選舉逼近，可能進一步提高美國政府推動局勢緩和的動力。
花旗估計，荷姆茲海峽持續關閉的機率約20%至25%。若封鎖持續，布蘭特原油價格可能升至每桶110至120美元；若衝突進一步升級至雙方相互摧毀能源基礎設施的極端情境，機率則僅約5%至10%。
反之，一旦荷姆茲海峽恢復通航，全球石油市場可能迅速轉為供過於求，過剩規模估計達每日300萬至400萬桶。

花旗續看多黃金　回檔反而可能提供買點

花旗認為，荷姆茲海峽重新開放帶來的影響不僅限於油價。能源價格下滑可望降低高油價對經濟成長與債務負擔造成的壓力，並改善整體市場環境。
花旗指出，8月黃金漲勢仍不夠穩固，主要由投機性與紙上交易推動，實體需求尚未充分跟進。因此，若金價短期出現回檔，反而可能成為買進機會。
若後續漲勢形成更強勁的價格動能，散戶資金也可能重新流入，進一步強化黃金上行趨勢。
即使荷姆茲海峽長期維持關閉，花旗仍認為黃金具備相對強勁的韌性，整體風險仍偏向上行。不過，若股市出現大幅修正，投資人可能出售黃金，以彌補其他資產的損失，金價仍可能面臨階段性回落壓力。
技術面來看，黃金100日均線約為每盎司4366美元，50日均線約為4218美元，而4000美元則構成重要支撐價位。
paras_en: The Middle East situation continues to sway energy markets, and the timing of the Hormuz Strait’s reopening has become a key factor influencing oil prices, inflation and precious metal trends. Citi’s latest commodity outlook notes that if the strait resumes navigation, a drop in oil prices could, via inflation, interest rates and the dollar, actually support gold.

Citi’s baseline scenario is that the Hormuz Strait will reopen for navigation in Q4 2026. The bank believes lower energy prices could ease inflation pressures, give the Federal Reserve room to move further toward easing, and potentially push the dollar and real interest rates lower, reducing the opportunity cost of holding gold.

Moreover, a fall in oil prices could also relieve fiscal and external balance pressures in emerging markets, freeing up physical gold demand that had been suppressed. If gold prices keep climbing and build stronger price momentum, retail investors may re‑enter the market, further bolstering the gold rally.

Citi maintains a bullish view on precious metals, setting a 0‑to‑3‑month target price for gold at $4,800 per ounce and a 6‑to‑12‑month target at $5,000, both above the current spot level of about $4,500.

If the Hormuz Strait re‑opens, oil prices could fall sharply. The energy market remains in an abnormal state. Citi has lifted its forecast for Brent crude in Q3 2026 to $86 a barrel, while keeping its Q4 2026 forecast at $70 and its 2027 outlook at $65 unchanged.
Global refined‑product prices have already exceeded $120 a barrel, though crude oil itself has not yet broken its 2022 peak. The market anomaly is mainly reflected in sharply higher refining margins.

Citi believes this situation cannot be sustained long‑term. It notes that Iran faces pressure from a depreciating currency and falling oil revenues, giving it a motive to break the blockade; at the same time, high oil prices are increasing pressure on the U.S. economy and financial markets, and as the November mid‑term elections approach, the U.S. government may have more incentive to push for de‑escalation.

Citi estimates the probability that the Hormuz Strait remains closed at about 20%‑25%. If the blockade persists, Brent could climb to $110‑$120 a barrel; if the conflict escalates to an extreme scenario where both sides destroy each other’s energy infrastructure, the probability is only about 5%‑10%.
Conversely, once the Hormuz Strait reopens, the global oil market could quickly swing to oversupply, with excess volumes estimated at 3‑4 million barrels per day.

Citi continues to be bullish on gold, saying the reopening’s impact extends beyond oil prices. Lower energy prices should reduce the strain that high oil costs place on economic growth and debt burdens, improving the overall market environment.

Citi points out that August’s gold rally remains fragile, driven mainly by speculative and paper trading, with physical demand lagging. Therefore, a short‑term pullback could actually present a buying opportunity.
If the subsequent rally develops stronger price momentum, retail capital may flow back in, further reinforcing the upward trend in gold.

Even if the Hormuz Strait stays closed for the long term, Citi still sees gold possessing relatively strong resilience, with overall risk tilted upward. However, a sharp equity market correction could lead investors to sell gold to offset losses elsewhere, subjecting prices to a temporary pull‑back pressure.
Technically, the 100‑day moving average for gold is around $4,366 per ounce, the 50‑day average about $4,218, and the $4,000 level serves as a key support point.

items.title: 台股市值重返152兆！法人看AI供應鏈多點開花 長多格局不變
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Value Returns to NT$152 Trillion! Institutions See AI Supply Chain Blooming, Bullish Outlook Unchanged
paras: 受美國聯準會官員樂觀談話激勵，升息疑慮降溫，美股與美債殖利率回穩，帶動台股本周高檔震盪，集中市場指數收在46551.13點，周線上漲219.68點，寫下連2紅，上市公司總市值重回152兆元。法人指出，儘管短線受總經與地緣政治干擾，但 AI 晶片升級已引爆 ABF 載板供需偏緊的硬需求，加上科技巨頭持續砸錢擴建基建，供應鏈獲利動能強勁，短線震盪反而是驗證台股基本面強韌的試金石，中長期多頭格局不變。
根據台灣證券交易所統計，全體上市公司總市值已上升至新台幣 152 兆 1,982 億元，單周市值增加約 7,473 億元。此外，美股費城半導體指數周五逆勢大漲 3.37%、收在 11,735 點，為台股科技股下周反彈添增柴火。
安聯投信台股團隊表示，近期台股走勢受到市場對利率政策預期反覆調整影響，情緒面波動加大，指數呈現震盪格局。先前雖受利多消息帶動強勢反彈，但隨後因市場雜音干擾而回測短期均線；4日則在聯準會官員對通膨前景表達樂觀看法後，美債殖利率回落，帶動風險性資產表現回溫，市場信心同步改善。
盤面方面，安聯投信台股團隊指出，近期類股輪動快速，電子權值股仍是支撐大盤的重要力量；市場焦點則由部分先前修正較深的電子股，逐漸擴散至被動元件、散熱、PCB及相關設備等AI供應鏈族群，呈現多點同步走揚格局。
面對市場受消息面干擾而出現波動，安聯台灣大壩基金經理人蕭惠中表示，從產業面觀察，AI晶片持續迭代升級，帶動ABF載板層數與面積需求明顯提升。然而供給成長速度仍不及需求增幅，使產業供需維持偏緊格局，並有助於價格表現，投資團隊持續看好相關族群的中長期發展機會。
蕭惠中進一步指出，就基本面而言，目前尚未因市場雜音而出現明顯轉折。根據產業調研，全球科技巨頭仍持續投入AI基礎建設與自研晶片開發，在AI需求擴張及產品規格升級帶動下，相關供應鏈訂單與營收動能維持強勁，受惠範圍可望進一步擴大，台股整體基本面仍偏向正向發展。
展望後市，蕭惠中認為，企業獲利仍是推動台股表現最重要的核心動能。受惠AI長期趨勢帶動，市場預期台股企業今、明年獲利仍將維持成長，即便短期受總體經濟與資金面因素干擾而出現震盪整理，中長期多頭架構仍具延續基礎。
安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF基金(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆則表示，在市場快速輪動環境下，主動式投資有助掌握不同產業與題材機會。透過「高息打底、成長加值」策略，兼顧收益需求與資本成長潛力，聚焦AI供應鏈及半導體產業，並透過主動選股掌握輪動機會，兼顧收益與資本增值需求。

paras_en: Boosted by optimistic remarks from U.S. Federal Reserve officials, concerns over rate hikes have cooled, and U.S. stocks and Treasury yields have steadied, leading Taiwan stocks to trade in a high‑range oscillation this week. The main market index closed at 46,551.13 points, up 219.68 points for the week, marking a second consecutive gain and bringing the total market capitalization of listed companies back to NT$152 trillion.

According to Taiwan Stock Exchange data, the total market value of all listed companies has risen to NT$152.1982 trillion, an increase of about NT$747.3 billion for the week. In addition, the U.S. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 3.37% on Friday, closing at 11,735 points, adding fuel to a potential rebound in Taiwan’s tech stocks next week.

Allianz Global Investors’ Taiwan equity team said that recent Taiwan market moves have been affected by repeated adjustments in expectations for rate policy, heightening sentiment volatility and creating an oscillating pattern in the index. Although earlier bullish rebounds were driven by positive news, the market later retested short‑term moving averages amid noise; on the 4th, after a Fed official expressed optimism about inflation, Treasury yields fell, risk assets recovered and market confidence improved.

On the market side, the Allianz team noted that sector rotation has been rapid, with heavyweight electronics stocks still underpinning the market. Focus has shifted from previously deep‑corrected electronics stocks to passive components, thermal solutions, PCBs and related equipment within the AI supply chain, showing a multi‑point, synchronized rally.

Facing volatility from news‑driven market swings, Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung observed that AI chip upgrades continue to drive higher layer counts and area demand for ABF substrates. However, supply growth lags behind demand, keeping the industry’s supply‑demand balance tight and supporting price performance; the team remains bullish on the medium‑ to long‑term prospects of these groups.

Hsu added that, fundamentally, there has been no clear turning point despite market noise. Industry research shows global tech giants are still pouring money into AI infrastructure and in‑house chip development. Expanding AI demand and higher product specs keep order and revenue momentum strong, broadening the beneficiary base and keeping Taiwan’s overall fundamentals positive.

Looking ahead, Hsu believes corporate earnings remain the key driver of Taiwan market performance. Fueled by the long‑term AI trend, the market expects Taiwanese companies to keep growing profits this year and next, even if short‑term macro and liquidity factors cause some consolidation; the medium‑ to long‑term bullish framework remains solid.

Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW) manager Liao Ben‑Long said that in a fast‑rotating market, active investing helps capture opportunities across industries and themes. Using a “high‑yield base, growth upside” strategy, the fund balances income needs with capital growth potential, focusing on the AI supply chain and semiconductor sector and leveraging active stock selection to seize rotation opportunities.

items.title: 從相親市場、戀愛實境秀到首爾大學！南韓AI半導體熱潮如何深刻改變社會角落？
paras: 南韓人工智慧(AI)股票漲勢正迅速改變社會的各個角落，影響範圍從擇偶市場一路延伸至大學校園。
在南韓的相親市場，醫師、律師和法官等專業人士傳統上一直是最受歡迎的對象。但隨著AI熱潮推升晶片產業榮景，在半導體業工作的族群因領取豐厚獎金，正成為新寵。
南韓婚友配對公司Gayeon發言人說：「最近我們發現，民眾對SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)和三星電子等半導體公司員工，以及從事AI相關工作的人的偏好明顯提高。」
三星電子和SK海力士今年稍早雙雙躋身市值1兆美元俱樂部，兩家公司股價今年來分別大漲約95%及135%。
晶片業巨擘發放的大筆獎金，也讓員工在相親市場上更具優勢：SK海力士去年同意把營業利益的10%提撥到員工獎金池，根據路透估算，每名員工可獲得約7億韓元獎金(超過50萬美元)，相當於南韓勞工去年平均年薪的15倍以上。
根據三星的薪資協議，記憶體晶片事業部員工的收入雖略低於SK海力士，但同樣是半導體產業榮景下的受惠者。
晶片業員工突然成為擇偶市場明星，也反映南韓單身族對婚姻的看法正在改變，愈來愈多人將結婚視為一種財務上的優勢。
南韓媒體甚至開始稱這種現象為「婚姻槓桿」(wedding leverage)，意指結合兩人的收入，是最快籌足購屋頭期款、或建立具規模投資組合的方法。
不過，晶片業人士在尋找伴侶時也變得愈來愈挑剔，財務條件並不一定是他們最重視的因素。Gayeon發言人說：「從事半導體相關工作的客戶，現在也愈來愈傾向從更廣泛的角度評估潛在伴侶，而不再只看職業或財務條件。」

從戀愛實境秀到大學校園

晶片業巨擘人氣飆升，甚至成為娛樂節目的創作靈感來源。YouTube頻道Teo於8月13日播出一檔安排三星電子與SK海力士員工配對的戀愛實境節目，目前累積觀看次數約65萬次。
Teo發言人說：「節目的構想是透過戀愛這個容易引發共鳴的題材，呈現上班族忙碌的日常生活，帶給觀眾熟悉感與娛樂性。」
他接著說：「節目推出的時間也正好與兩家公司受AI熱潮帶動的榮景相呼應，因此能引起更廣泛觀眾的共鳴。」
Netflix(NFLX-US)上月則推出綜藝節目《Rookie Kim's Stock Market Mission》，記錄一名知名喜劇演員的投資交易歷程。節目一開始，這名喜劇演員便買進幾股SK海力士股票，引起南韓散戶共鳴。南韓散戶約占全國人口的四分之一。
AI熱潮甚至正在影響高等教育，而這在南韓社會尤其重要。在被視為南韓「哈佛」的首爾大學，與AI相關工作的電機與電腦工程學系人氣大幅上升。
根據首爾大學資料，今年工程學院尚未決定主修的學生中，每10人就有九人選擇電機與電腦工程，而2023年每10人僅約兩人選擇該領域。
Lim表示：「南韓學生並不是把『AI』當成一個抽象主題來追逐，而是在追逐一條具體、看得見、可直接進入三星和SK海力士等硬體事業部的國內職涯管道。」相較於其他職涯選項，這些工作能在大型企業提供「更明確、更立即的回報」，包括穩定且固定的職位。

items.title: 英國國安新隱患？中國拖拉機恐洩露糧食安全情報
items.title_en: UK National Security New Threat? Chinese Tractors May Leak Food‑Security Intelligence
paras: 「五眼聯盟」是世界最大情報組織，作為成員國，英國這一次盯上了中國拖拉機。
據英國《每日電訊報》4日（周五）報導，一份專家報告指出，中國可能利用拖拉機及其他聯網農業機械對英國農戶展開間諜活動。
這份報告由英國工黨議員格雷姆·唐尼領導的安全技術聯盟（CST）發布。
報告提到，英國食品生產暴露於隱性安全風險之中，而這種風險就嵌入全國農場使用的工具裡；中國晶片現已普遍用於農機，包括GPS導航拖拉機、農業無人機和自動灌溉系統。
這份報告強調，與中國有關聯的組織若侵入農業設備，可窺探英國農場產量，並獲取有關英國糧食安全的情報。
《每日電訊報》看到的這份CST報告認為，農業部門對中國技術的依賴，對糧食安全構成更廣泛威脅。
CST說到具體威脅時，提到了作物產量、生產預測和牲畜數量等，稱這些間諜活動將使中國能夠識別英國食品生產系統中的壓力點。
報告呼籲英國內閣部長將聯網農業技術視為新興國家韌性威脅，並制定戰略，減少對高風險、受外國控制的通訊組件的依賴。
paras_en: The “Five Eyes” alliance is the world’s largest intelligence network, and as a member state, Britain this time has set its sights on Chinese tractors.
According to the UK’s Daily Telegraph on Friday the 4th, an expert report warned that China could use tractors and other connected agricultural machines to conduct espionage against British farmers.
The report was released by the Centre for Security and Technology (CST), led by Labour MP Graham Donny.

The report notes that UK food production is exposed to hidden security risks embedded in the tools used on farms nationwide; Chinese chips are now commonplace in agricultural equipment, including GPS‑guided tractors, farming drones and automated irrigation systems.
It stresses that organisations linked to China that infiltrate agricultural equipment could spy on UK farm yields and gather intelligence on Britain’s food‑security situation.
The Daily Telegraph’s copy of the CST report argues that the agricultural sector’s reliance on Chinese technology poses a broader threat to food security.

When detailing the specific threats, CST mentions crop yields, production forecasts and livestock numbers, saying such spying would enable China to pinpoint pressure points in the UK food‑production system.

The report calls on UK cabinet ministers to treat connected agri‑tech as an emerging national‑resilience threat and to devise a strategy to reduce dependence on high‑risk, foreign‑controlled communications components.

items.title: 中東航線海運價格大漲50% 運價比貨值還貴
items.title_en: Middle East Shipping Rates Surge 50%, Freight Costs Exceed Cargo Value
paras: 在義烏全球數貿中心，伊拉克客商阿里正挑選心儀衛浴產品。他告訴記者，今年以來中東航線的價格暴漲，讓他失去了很多中小買家訂單，因為在義烏採購的很多日用百貨，有的貨值不高，比如1萬美元左右的成本，卻要支付超過1萬美元的運費，顯得很不滑算。
阿里的客戶主要在中東，如伊拉克、沙烏地阿拉伯、阿聯等地。他表示，現在做生意很難，買貨的價格沒有海運費高，訂單量比以前少了一半。
本輪漲價核心源於中東地緣衝突，荷姆茲海峽、曼德海峽通航受阻，船東為規避風險縮減運力、暫緩航線恢復，加上油價上漲、航線繞行、港口擁堵，大幅抬升航運附加成本。
據《央視》5日（周六）報導，7月下旬以來，中東航線海運價格大幅跳漲，以上海港到達曼港為例，一個40英尺標準貨櫃的運價，從6,600美元左右一路突破10,000美元關口，漲幅超過50%。
有貨代公司負責人稱，中東航線的艙位現在是一艙難求，即使訂到艙位也會因為各種原因推遲或取消。
浙江賽福威供應鏈管理公司倉庫管理員周曉民說，這些日用百貨，貨值在2萬美元到3萬美元左右，沙國客人的貨大概有兩個櫃，因為海運費太高，放在這裡已有三個月，想等海運費下來以後再走。
上海天駿航運公司總經理陳翔表示，8月24日到8月30日的船期價格，同樣到傑貝阿里的價格是8,100美元。現在最高到達曼已經是11,650美元，基本上每周上漲幅度是800美元到1,000美元。
上海航運交易所最新數據顯示，上海出口貨櫃運價指數已連漲五周。
業界人士指出，「聖嬰現象」帶來的極端天氣，影響部分運河通航，對港口運力也產生了一定影響，加上聖誕備貨旺季到來，多重因素導致中東航線運力結構性緊張。
國信期貨首席分析師顧馮達表示，多個港口、多個運河受限，影響著運力周轉，使得不同區域之間有效運力被系統性抽乾。搶出口這波潮流一定程度上擠佔了運價，也受到短期颱風季擾動，運力不穩、運價上漲可能是近期趨勢。
paras_en: At the Yiwu Global Trade Center, Iraqi buyer Ali is selecting his preferred bathroom fixtures. He told reporters that since the start of the year, prices on Middle‑East routes have skyrocketed, causing him to lose many orders from small and medium buyers because many everyday goods purchased in Yiwu have low values – for example, items costing around $10,000 – yet the shipping fee exceeds $10,000, making the deal uneconomical.

Ali’s customers are mainly in the Middle East, such as Iraq, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. He said doing business now is very difficult; the purchase price of goods is lower than the sea‑freight cost, and order volumes are about half of what they used to be.

The current price hike stems from geopolitical conflict in the Middle East. Navigation through the Hormuz Strait and the Bab al‑Mandeb Strait has been disrupted, prompting ship owners to cut capacity and delay route restorations to avoid risk. Combined with rising oil prices, longer detours and port congestion, the additional shipping costs have surged dramatically.

According to CCTV on the 5th (Saturday), since late July Middle‑East sea‑freight rates have jumped sharply. Using the Shanghai‑to‑Jebel Ali route as an example, the price for a standard 40‑foot container rose from roughly $6,600 to break the $10,000 barrier, an increase of more than 50%.
A freight forwarder’s manager said that cabin space on Middle‑East routes is now extremely scarce; even when space is secured, shipments are often delayed or cancelled for various reasons.

Zhejiang Saifuwei Supply Chain Management’s warehouse supervisor Zhou Xiaomin said the everyday goods in question are valued at about $20,000‑$30,000. A Saudi client’s cargo occupies roughly two containers, but because the freight cost is so high the containers have been sitting for three months, waiting for rates to drop before they are shipped.

Chen Xiang, general manager of Shanghai Tianjun Shipping, said the price for voyages scheduled between August 24 and August 30 to Jebel Ali was $8,100. Currently the highest rate to Jebel Ali has reached $11,650, with weekly increases of roughly $800‑$1,000.
Latest data from the Shanghai Shipping Exchange show that the Shanghai export container freight index has risen for five consecutive weeks.

Industry insiders note that the extreme weather associated with the El Niño phenomenon has affected the navigation of some canals and reduced port capacity. Together with the upcoming Christmas stocking season, these multiple factors have created a structurally tight capacity on Middle‑East routes.

Gu Fengda, chief analyst at Guoxin Futures, said that restrictions on multiple ports and canals are limiting vessel turnover, systematically draining effective capacity between regions. The scramble for exports is squeezing freight rates, and short‑term typhoon activity adds further volatility; unstable capacity and rising rates are likely to persist in the near term.

items.title: 房地合一重購退稅踩雷！他因「這原因」賣房百萬稅款全遭追回
items.title_en: Land-and-House Integrated Tax Re‑purchase Refund Pitfall! He Lost All the Million‑Dollar Tax Refund Because of This Reason
paras: 財政部北區國稅局表示，個人適用房地合一稅重購自住房地稅額扣抵或退還後，重購之新房地在5年內若改作其他用途或再行移轉，國稅局將依法追繳原扣抵或退還的稅款。即使民眾主張因工作調職等非自願因素出售，仍不符自住規定，無法免除追繳。民眾在申請房地合一稅重購退稅時，務必特別留意5年列管期的各項限制，以免失去稅務優惠權益。
依據所得稅法第14條之8規定，個人適用重購自住房地稅額扣抵或退還，無論是「先售後購」或「先購後售」，買賣時間均須在2年之內。適用條件包含本人、配偶或未成年子女須於出售及購買房屋辦竣戶籍登記並實際居住，且該房地無出租、供營業或執行業務使用。符合條件者，可依重購價額占出售價額的比率，計算退還或扣抵應納稅額。
不過，政府為防止短期炒作及投機行為，重購退稅設有嚴格的「5年列管期」。只要在重購後5年內將新房地移轉所有權、遷出戶籍、未實際自住，或是改為出租、轉供營業與執行業務使用，國稅局都會依法追繳原本扣抵或退還的稅額。
北區國稅局舉例，轄內甲君於2021年6月以865萬元出售原自住房地，並申報繳納房地合一稅108萬元。隨後甲君於2022年9月以838萬元重購新房地，因符合規定，國稅局核准按比例退還已繳稅額104萬餘元。然而，甲君卻在2024年3月將該新房地再次出售，國稅局因而依法追繳原先已退還的104萬餘元稅額。
甲君雖提出復查，主張是因為工作調職才不得不出售重購的新房地，屬於非自願出售，希望能免予追繳。但國稅局認為，新房地移轉他人後已無供其個人自住使用的事實，並不符合重購自住優惠政策的初衷，因此駁回其復查申請。
國稅局特別提醒民眾，重購退稅是給予長期自住者的租稅優惠，5年內不得任意變更用途或賣出。民眾若對房地合一稅重購退稅的法令規範或適用條件有任何疑問，可洽詢國稅局免費服務專線0800-000321，以保障自身的節稅權益。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance’s North District National Tax Bureau says that when an individual claims a tax credit or refund for the land‑and‑house integrated tax on a re‑purchased primary residence, if the newly bought property is used for another purpose or transferred again within five years, the bureau will legally recover the previously credited or refunded tax. Even if the seller argues that the sale was forced by a job transfer or other involuntary reasons, it does not meet the self‑occupation requirement and the recovery cannot be waived. Taxpayers applying for the re‑purchase refund must pay close attention to all restrictions during the five‑year monitoring period to avoid losing the tax benefit.

According to Article 14‑8 of the Income Tax Act, individuals eligible for a tax credit or refund on a re‑purchased primary residence must complete the purchase and sale within two years, whether the transaction is “sell first, buy later” or “buy first, sell later.” The conditions require that the taxpayer, spouse, or minor children register the household and actually reside in the sold and purchased homes, and that the property is not rented out, used for business, or for any commercial activity. Qualified taxpayers can calculate the refundable or creditable tax amount based on the ratio of the re‑purchase price to the sale price.

However, to curb short‑term speculation, the re‑purchase refund is subject to a strict five‑year monitoring period. If, within five years of the re‑purchase, the owner transfers the new property’s title, moves the household registration out, fails to actually reside there, or converts it to rental, business, or other commercial use, the National Tax Bureau will legally reclaim the originally credited or refunded tax.

The North District Tax Bureau gave an example: Mr. Jia sold his original primary residence in June 2021 for NT$8.65 million and paid NT$1.08 million in land‑and‑house integrated tax. He then re‑purchased a new property in September 2022 for NT$8.38 million; because he met the requirements, the bureau approved a proportional refund of over NT$1.04 million. However, Jia sold the new property again in March 2024, prompting the bureau to recover the previously refunded NT$1.04 million in tax.

Jia filed for a review, claiming the sale was forced by a job transfer and therefore involuntary, seeking exemption from the recovery. The bureau rejected his claim, stating that once the new property was transferred to another party it no longer served personal residence purposes and thus violated the original intent of the re‑purchase self‑occupation tax incentive.

The bureau reminds the public that the re‑purchase refund is a tax incentive for long‑term homeowners and cannot be arbitrarily changed in use or sold within five years. Anyone with questions about the legal provisions or eligibility for the land‑and‑house integrated tax re‑purchase refund should contact the free service line 0800‑000321 to protect their tax‑saving rights.

安聯投信台股團隊表示，近期台股走勢受到市場對利率政策預期反覆調整影響，情緒面波動加大，指數呈現震盪格局。先前雖受利多消息帶動強勢反彈，但隨後因市場雜音干擾而回測短期均線；4日則在聯準會官員對通膨前景表達樂觀看法後，美債殖利率回落，帶動風險性資產表現回溫，市場信心同步改善。

面對市場受消息面干擾而出現波動，安聯台灣大壩基金經理人蕭惠中表示，從產業面觀察，AI晶片持續迭代升級，帶動ABF載板層數與面積需求明顯提升。然而供給成長速度仍不及需求增幅，使產業供需維持偏緊格局，並有助於價格表現，投資團隊持續看好相關族群的中長期發展機會。

The main market index closed at 46,551.13 points, up 219.68 points for the week, marking a second consecutive gain and bringing the total market capitalization of listed companies back to NT$152 trillion.

In addition, the U.S. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 3.37% on Friday, closing at 11,735 points, adding fuel to a potential rebound in Taiwan’s tech stocks next week.

Allianz Global Investors’ Taiwan equity team said that recent Taiwan market moves have been affected by repeated adjustments in expectations for rate policy, heightening sentiment volatility and creating an oscillating pattern in the index. Although earlier bullish rebounds were driven by positive news, the market later retested short‑term moving averages amid noise; on the 4th, after a Fed official expressed optimism about inflation, Treasury yields fell, risk assets recovered and market confidence improved.

On the market side, the Allianz team noted that sector rotation has been rapid, with heavyweight electronics stocks still underpinning the market. Focus has shifted from previously deep‑corrected electronics stocks to passive components, thermal solutions, PCBs and related equipment within the AI supply chain, showing a multi‑point, synchronized rally.

Facing volatility from news‑driven market swings, Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung observed that AI chip upgrades continue to drive higher layer counts and area demand for ABF substrates. However, supply growth lags behind demand, keeping the industry’s supply‑demand balance tight and supporting price performance; the team remains bullish on the medium‑ to long‑term prospects of these groups.

Industry research shows global tech giants are still pouring money into AI infrastructure and in‑house chip development. Expanding AI demand and higher product specs keep order and revenue momentum strong, broadening the beneficiary base and keeping Taiwan’s overall fundamentals positive.

Fueled by the long‑term AI trend, the market expects Taiwanese companies to keep growing profits this year and next, even if short‑term macro and liquidity factors cause some consolidation; the medium‑ to long‑term bullish framework remains solid.

items.title_en: Taiwan Firms Push Micro LED into Optical Communication Ecosystem; FuCai and KY Target Short-Range Optical Transmission Opportunities
paras: AI帶動資料傳輸量呈現爆炸性成長，使得光進銅退趨勢加速成形。富采(3714-TW)與同集團的、鼎元(2426-TW)以及Micro LED先驅錼創科技-KY(6854-TW)，在本周登場的SEMICON Taiwan 2026半導體展中，同步將Micro LED技術自傳統顯示領域大舉跨足非顯示市場，強攻AI資料中心十公尺內短距離高速傳輸與CPO共封裝光學商機，為台系供應鏈開闢嶄新藍海。
針對非顯示光通訊應用的商業化進程，台廠普遍看好未來兩年內將逐步顯現成果。錼創董事長李允立指出，Micro LED光通訊技術主要鎖定十公尺以內的短距傳輸並替代銅線，看好該技術在兩年左右邁向商用。
富采則表示，旗下Micro LED CPO技術表現已跨過過往頻寬限制並符合業界商用標準，但考量整體光通訊生態系仍在建立且相關可靠度驗證需耗時三千小時以上，預期整體生態系發展時程將放眼2028年。
此外，富采規劃現金減資45.8%以消除約3.38億股，實收資本額將由73.79億元降至40億元，新股預計於11月16日恢復上市，配合營運轉型與瘦身策略，帶動市場資金進一步聚焦其新技術卡位布局。
此次富采聯手友達、鼎元、達興材料(5234-TW)及康寧展出的系統級Micro LED CPO光學模組，由富采負責Micro LED發射光源，鼎元提供Micro PD接收元件，友達則統籌巨量轉移、光學耦合及重分布層電路布線等系統架構
相較於富采的集團艦隊布局，錼創則從架構特性直攻銅線極限。李允立分析，光通訊傳輸現階段以800G與1.6T為主，未來邁入1.6T乃至3.2T時代，銅線的傳輸極限更為顯著，Micro LED具備發光角度廣的優勢，對光纖對準精度要求較低，能大幅降低光纖陣列單元的對位難度與封裝成本，其每位元能耗亦優於銅線及雷射方案，目前錼創已參與數個專案並處於設計測試階段。
paras_en: AI-driven data traffic is exploding, accelerating the shift from optical fiber to copper withdrawal. FuCai (3714‑TW) together with its sister company DingYuan (2426‑TW) and Micro LED pioneer KY Technology (6854‑TW) showcased at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 how Micro LED technology is moving from traditional display applications into non‑display markets, targeting short‑range high‑speed transmission within ten metres for AI data centres and CPO co‑packaged optical solutions, opening a new blue‑sea market for Taiwan’s supply chain.

Regarding the commercialization of non‑display optical communication, Taiwanese manufacturers are generally optimistic that results will start to appear within the next two years. KY chairman Li Yun‑li said Micro LED optical communication is aimed at short‑range transmission within ten metres to replace copper wires, and expects the technology to become commercial in about two years.

FuCai said its Micro LED CPO technology has already surpassed previous bandwidth limits and meets industry commercial standards, but because the overall optical communication ecosystem is still being built and reliability verification requires more than 3,000 hours, the company expects the ecosystem development timeline to extend to 2028.

In addition, FuCai plans a cash reduction of 45.8% to eliminate about 338 million shares, reducing its paid‑in capital from NT$7.379 billion to NT$4.0 billion. New shares are expected to resume trading on November 16, supporting its operational transformation and slimming strategy and drawing market capital toward its new‑technology positioning.

The system‑level Micro LED CPO optical modules displayed jointly by FuCai, AU Optronics, DingYuan, Daxing Materials (5234‑TW) and Corning feature FuCai providing the Micro LED light source, DingYuan supplying the Micro PD receiver, and AU Optronics handling massive transfer, optical coupling and the redistribution layer circuit routing.

Compared with FuCai’s group‑wide strategy, KY attacks the copper‑wire limit directly from an architectural standpoint. Li Yun‑li explained that current optical communication operates mainly at 800 Gbps and 1.6 Tbps; as the industry moves to 1.6 Tbps and eventually 3.2 Tbps, copper’s transmission limits become more pronounced. Micro LED’s wide emission angle reduces the precision needed for fiber alignment, greatly lowering the alignment difficulty and packaging cost of fiber‑array units, and its per‑bit energy consumption outperforms copper and laser solutions. KY is already involved in several projects and is in the design‑testing phase.

paras_en: As co‑packaged optics (CPO) accelerates toward 3‑D heterogeneous integration of PICs and EICs, test verification is also undergoing a critical upgrade. After advanced bonding, new interface defects, alignment errors, and wafer warpage can introduce failure risks, prompting the industry to adopt Insertion 2 testing, which extends yield control from individual components to the post‑bond optoelectronic interconnect quality, preventing defective parts from entering the high‑cost packaging stage.
Yield control now extends to optoelectronic interconnects; Insertion 2 safeguards early‑stage screening.

Traditional Insertion 1 can only confirm that the PIC and the EIC are each good, but once they are hybrid‑bonded, full‑scale verification must rely on Insertion 2. This step occurs after hybrid bonding is completed but before the wafer is finally dicing, rigorously checking DC functionality, contact interconnects, electro‑to‑optical and optical‑to‑electrical modulation. The wafer‑level yield map generated here effectively prevents bad die from proceeding to the high‑value optical engine assembly, dramatically reducing downstream packaging waste and cementing its indispensable role in CPO mass‑production flow.
Dual‑side optoelectronic co‑measurement technology has a high barrier; automatic alignment becomes the make‑or‑break factor for volume production.

Compared with the earlier single‑side testing, the technical barrier of Insertion 2 has risen sharply. Using COUPE‑type optoelectronic integration as an example, the equipment must contact the EIC input signals on one side via a probe card while simultaneously aligning an optical probe or fiber array on the opposite side to the PIC. Because optical coupling is extremely sensitive to vibration, temperature and wafer warpage, equipment vendors now focus not merely on measurement completion but on automatically searching for the coupling position, real‑time correction, and multi‑station parallelism, driving the shift toward fully automated platforms.

items.title: 聯發科首創包場六福村水陸雙樂園 參與員工及眷屬近2.5萬名
items.title_en: MediaTek Holds Exclusive Family Day at Lihpao Land's Dual Water and Land Parks, Attracting Nearly 25,000 Employees and Their Families
paras: 聯發科(2454-TW)今(5)日與明(6)日包場六福村主題樂園及水樂園，盛大舉辦2026家庭日，成為台灣首家於六福村同步舉辦水陸雙園區家庭日的企業。繼去年創下單一企業包場台北大巨蛋觀賞職業棒球賽的規模紀錄後，今年預計再吸引近2.5萬名員工及眷屬熱情參與，共度歡樂難忘的家庭時光。
今年家庭日於9月5日舉行啟動儀式，由聯發科副董事長暨執行長蔡力行、總經理暨營運長陳冠州、共同營運長暨財務長顧大為以及資深副總經理暨人資長林秀瑜共同出席。在特別打造、高達六米的「發哥」巨型吉祥物氣球前，與現場員工及眷屬一同揭開家庭日序幕。
現場主管代表亦於儀式後發送聯發科技限定版乖乖，並與同仁及家人開心互動合影。聯發科技表示，家庭是員工持續前行的重要力量，感謝所有同仁及家人長期以來的陪伴與鼓勵，也期待與大家攜手成長、共創未來。
聯發科指出，家庭日不僅是公司年度最受期待的員工活動之一，也展現公司重視員工福祉與家庭支持的企業文化。公司擁有84個多元員工社團，豐沛的社團能量也延伸至家庭日舞台，由熱舞社及熱音社同仁接力演出，透過舞蹈與音樂展現聯發人在工作之外的創意與熱情。
除員工社團表演外，公司也特別邀請實力派歌手韋禮安、戴愛玲，以及人氣樂團理想混蛋、宇宙人與人氣啦啦隊Monster輪番登場，陪伴員工及眷屬同樂。同時，聯發科也持續透過實際行動支持公益，攜手中華民國唐氏症基金會推出公益禮品，展現深耕在地、關懷社會及實踐永續發展的企業精神。
聯發科致力於打造兼顧職涯發展與家庭照顧的友善職場環境，並榮獲《親子天下》2025年「友善家庭職場獎」肯定。公司於竹科總部設有自營幼兒園，並與27間特約托育機構合作，協助同仁安心育兒；同時提供每胎新台幣10,000元生育補助，領養家庭亦享有同等支持。
此外，公司持續推動彈性上下班制度、家庭照顧假及急難救助機制，滿足不同生命階段同仁的需求，並將員工照護方案延伸至眷屬，除可使用與員工相同的多元健康檢查方案外，亦可運用公司提供的場地參與眷屬班課程。展望未來，聯發科技將持續優化家庭友善措施，全方位陪伴聯發人及其家庭在人生不同階段穩健前行，共同迎向更美好的未來。
paras_en: MediaTek (2454‑TW) today (the 5th) and tomorrow (the 6th) will exclusively book Lihpao Land’s theme park and water park to host a grand 2026 Family Day, becoming the first company in Taiwan to hold a simultaneous water‑and‑land family event at Lihpao. After last year’s record‑setting private booking of a professional baseball game at Taipei’s Big Dome, the company expects to draw close to 25,000 employees and their families to share a joyful, unforgettable family time.

The Family Day kicks off on September 5 with a ceremony attended by MediaTek Vice Chairman and CEO Cai Lixing, General Manager and COO Chen Guanzhou, Co‑COO and CFO Gu Dawei, and Senior Vice President and HR Head Lin Xiuyu. In front of a specially made six‑meter‑tall “Fa‑Ge” mascot balloon, they unveiled the Family Day together with on‑site staff and their families.

After the ceremony, a supervisor on behalf of the company distributed limited‑edition MediaTek “Guai‑Guai” snacks and took happy photos with colleagues and their families. MediaTek said that family is the vital force behind employees’ continued progress, thanking all staff and their families for their long‑term support and looking forward to growing together and creating the future.

MediaTek noted that Family Day is not only one of the most anticipated annual employee events, but also showcases the company’s culture of caring for employee welfare and family support. The firm has more than 84 diverse employee clubs, whose vibrant energy extends to the Family Day stage, with performances by the dance club and music club that display MediaTek staff’s creativity and passion beyond work.

In addition to employee club performances, the company invited popular singers Wei Li‑an and Dai Ailing, as well as well‑known bands Ideal Bastards, Cosmic People, and the fan‑favorite cheerleading squad Monster, to entertain employees and their families. MediaTek also continues its public‑welfare actions by partnering with the Taiwan Down Syndrome Foundation to launch charitable gifts, demonstrating its commitment to local community care, social responsibility, and sustainable development.

MediaTek is dedicated to creating a workplace that balances career development with family care, earning the 2025 “Family‑Friendly Workplace Award” from Parent‑Child World. The company operates an on‑site nursery at its Hsinchu Science Park headquarters and collaborates with 27 contracted childcare providers to help staff raise children with peace of mind; it also provides a NT$10,000 birth subsidy per child, with equal support for adoptive families.

Furthermore, the firm continues to promote flexible work hours, family‑care leave, and emergency assistance mechanisms to meet employees’ needs at different life stages, extending care benefits to their families. In addition to the same comprehensive health‑check options available to employees, family members can also join company‑offered classes and activities. Looking ahead, MediaTek will keep enhancing family‑friendly measures, supporting its people and their families through every life stage toward a brighter future.

items.title: 鴻海8月營收創同期新高AI伺服器需求強勁、Q3表現估優於市場預期
items.title_en: Foxconn's August Revenue Hits Record High for the Period, Strong AI Server Demand, Q3 Outlook Likely Beats Market Expectations
paras: 2026年09月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 鴻海(2317-TW)表示，受惠AI相關需求持續強勁，加上資通訊(ICT)產品進入下半年傳統旺季，第3季營運動能可望逐步升溫，目前公司對第3季的業務能見度較上月進一步改善，整體表現預期將優於市場預期。
鴻海是輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)最大的伺服器製造商，同時也是蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)主要供應商之一，近年成為AI基礎建設投資熱潮的重要受惠者。公司上月公布第2季財報時，利潤年增35%，不僅維持強勁成長，也優於分析師預期，反映AI伺服器需求持續支撐營運。
鴻海指出，隨著AI需求持續成長，以及ICT產品進入下半年旺季，第3季營運預期逐步增強。相較前一個月，公司目前對第3季訂單及營運的掌握度有所提升，因此預期整體表現將優於市場原先預估，但公司並未提供具體財務預測數字。
最新營收數據也顯示成長動能延續。鴻海8月營收達9,218億新台幣，年增率51.98%，創歷年同期新高，並且連續第2個月營收突破9,000億新台幣，顯示AI伺服器與旺季需求正持續推升公司營收規模。
TrendForce指出，第3季雲端運算與AI系統的儲存需求仍將走強，主要受到生成式AI服務持續普及、雲端基礎建設支出增加，以及部分輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US) AI伺服器機櫃出貨帶動。隨著AI伺服器逐步朝rack-scale機櫃級架構發展，需求也從GPU向企業級SSD、網通、散熱、電源及整機組裝等環節擴散，顯示AI基礎建設投資正持續轉化為實際硬體出貨。
鴻海股價週五上漲3.4%，表現優於台股大盤1.5%的漲幅，而8月營收數據是在收盤後公布。
不過，鴻海對後續展望仍保持審慎。公司表示，全球政治與經濟局勢仍具高度波動性，需要持續觀察相關變化可能帶來的影響，但並未進一步說明具體風險。鴻海一向不提供數字化財測，因此後續AI伺服器需求、客戶拉貨速度，以及下半年ICT旺季強度，將是觀察第3季實際表現能否進一步超越市場預期的重點。

paras_en: September 5, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Foxconn (2317-TW) said that continued strong AI‑related demand, combined with ICT products entering the traditional peak season in the second half of the year, should gradually warm up its Q3 operating momentum. The company’s visibility for Q3 business has improved further since last month, and overall performance is expected to exceed market expectations.

Foxconn is Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) largest server manufacturer and also one of Apple’s (AAPL-US) main suppliers, and has become a key beneficiary of the AI infrastructure investment boom in recent years. When it released its Q2 results last month, profit grew 35% year‑over‑year, not only maintaining robust growth but also beating analysts’ forecasts, reflecting that AI server demand continues to support operations.

Foxconn noted that as AI demand keeps expanding and ICT products move into the second‑half peak season, its Q3 operating outlook is strengthening step by step. Compared with the previous month, the company now has a better grasp of Q3 orders and operations, so it expects overall performance to be better than the market’s original estimate, though it did not provide specific financial guidance numbers.

The latest revenue figures also show the growth momentum persisting. Foxconn’s August revenue reached NT$921.8 billion, up 51.98% year‑over‑year, setting a record high for the same month in its history and marking the second consecutive month of revenue exceeding NT$900 billion, indicating that AI server and peak‑season demand are continuously boosting the company’s sales scale.

TrendForce said that storage demand for cloud computing and AI systems will remain strong in Q3, driven mainly by the continued proliferation of generative AI services, higher cloud‑infrastructure spending, and shipments of Nvidia (NVDA-US) AI server racks. As AI servers gradually shift toward rack‑scale architectures, demand is spreading from GPUs to enterprise‑grade SSDs, networking, cooling, power supplies and full‑system integration, showing that AI infrastructure investment is steadily translating into actual hardware shipments.
Foxconn’s stock rose 3.4% on Friday, outperforming the broader Taiwan market’s 1.5% gain, and the August revenue data were released after the market close.

However, Foxconn remains cautious about the outlook. The company said global political and economic conditions remain highly volatile and will need to be closely monitored for potential impacts, without detailing specific risks. Foxconn typically does not provide quantitative forecasts, so future AI server demand, customer pull‑through speed, and the strength of the ICT peak season in the second half will be key factors to watch to see if Q3 performance can further exceed market expectations.
